notes: New maps for everyone: Club House (beta) and Warehouse (beta), from Chaos Theory, with their own 3D models in the map list; laptops and gates work in every mode. Proximity voice chat: hold V (X / Square on a pad). The host can switch spawn protection off for a match in the lobby (under Bots). Club House pipe in the steam bath and the roof ladder can be climbed now; Warehouse Sector 3 machine ladders fixed.
